title.zh: 关于里能联系到我们了
title.en: The About panel can reach us now

highlights.zh: 设置里的关于新增两行：联系地址，以及发邮件上报问题。
highlights.en: The About panel in settings has two new rows: the contact address, and a line to report a bug by email.

highlights.zh: 上报那条带着主题，于是来信是标好的，而不是一句无题的问候。
highlights.en: The bug line carries a subject, so a report arrives labelled rather than as a bare greeting.
